assumptions.conductivities: Uniform 0.3 W/mK dielectric and 385 W/mK copper are illustrative, not measured from the board's actual laminate or plating.
assumptions.vias: 0.025 mm plating thickness is illustrative; via shell conductance is an approximate parallel vertical path.
assumptions.cooling: Top and bottom h=10 W/m2K are illustrative prescribed coefficients; no airflow or radiation is solved.
assumptions.component_losses_and_paths: Q1/Q2/Q3 power and Rjc/Rcase-board are hypothetical. Imported copper pad lands locate case-to-board heat coupling; package solids and pin/lead conduction are not resolved.
assumptions.scope: Layered finite-volume board approximation, one depth cell per physical stackup layer, rectangular board bounds, no tetrahedra or 3D part blocks.
